feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 September 2026 11:17am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 08 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland and low pressure near Scotland as weak fronts and troughs affect the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 to 7, veering northwest 5 or 6 overnight, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough overnight, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, soon backing south or southwest 3 to 5, backing south 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south at first, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then rain approaching from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
